newsitem.title: UK: BA, AA talks stall - paper.
newsitem.headline: BA, AA talks stall - paper.

text.p: UK trade and industry secretary Margaret Beckett and European competition commissioner Karel Van Miert failed to settle longstanding disagreements about the alliance between British Airways Plc and American Airlines, the Financial Times said on Wednesday.
The two sides agreed to further discussions later this week, the paper said.
Talks in Brussels centred on the issue of how many slots the alliance would control at London's Heathrow airport, the paper said. It was the most serious sticking point.
It said that Brussels was taking a tougher line on how many slots should be ceded in return for approval.
The two sides also were at odds over flight frequencies, the paper said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
